title: The other-claim test-routing notice names the bound claim by its canonical work id when that claim has no named root
outcome: The other-claim test-routing notice names the bound claim by its canonical work id when that claim has no named root
acceptance: When the bound claim has no named source root, the notice for a test in another claim's root names the bound item by its short ref, as it names the other item; a test pins the line.
